repository.name: web
repository.description: Larkspur web app and offline-first PWA

issues.title: iOS evicts offline photos when storage is low
issues.body:
A pilot inspector lost 30 photos: iOS Safari evicted our IndexedDB data after 7 days of
not opening the app, and the outbox had unsent full-resolution photos (8 MB each).

issues.title: Redux boilerplate is slowing us down
issues.body:
Adding the client-history screen took a slice, 4 thunks, 6 selectors and the
loading/error/stale flags, plus cache invalidation when a report changes. ~80% of the store
is just cached server data. And replaying thunks from the offline outbox is fragile.

Proposal: TanStack Query for server state, something tiny (Zustand) for UI state.

issues.title: Initial JS bundle is 1.1 MB
issues.body: Lighthouse on a mid-range Android: 6.2 s TTI. The PDF preview library and moment.js are in the main chunk.

issues.title: Safari: Background Sync never fires
issues.body: As expected, Safari has no Background Sync API. Outbox only drains when the app is open. Tracking here in case WebKit ships it.

issues.title: Print layout route for server-side PDF rendering
issues.body: For the Playwright switch the PDF worker will open a page in the web app. Can we get `/print/reports/[id]` that renders the report without app chrome, authenticated by a one-time token?

issues.title: Search empty state says 'Elasticsearch error'
issues.body: Leftover copy from the ES days. Should be a friendly 'No reports match'.

issues.title: Customer request: native iOS app
issues.body:
Harbor & Pine Inspections (35 seats, renewal in June) asked for a native iOS app. Their
reasons: App Store presence for their inspectors and better photo uploads in the
background. Do we revisit ADR-0008?

issues.title: Accessibility audit findings
issues.body: Audit for an enterprise RFP found: missing labels on checklist toggles, low contrast on the severity chips, and focus lost after closing the photo viewer.

issues.title: Redirect loop on login for Brightwell SSO users
issues.body: Brightwell users bounce between /login and their Entra ID page after the WorkOS switch.

issues.title: Two inspectors editing the same report offline overwrite each other
issues.body:
Firms with two-person inspections (one outside, one inside) both edit the same report
offline. On sync, whoever syncs last overwrites whole sections.

issues.title: Photos from some Android phones appear sideways
issues.body: Client-side compression drops EXIF orientation on Samsung devices.

pull_requests.title: Next.js app skeleton
pull_requests.body: App Router, TypeScript strict, ESLint, Vitest, Playwright for e2e. Nothing product-facing yet.

pull_requests.title: Redux Toolkit store with report, client and template slices
pull_requests.body:
Per ADR-0006. One slice per domain, thunks for API calls, `createEntityAdapter` for
normalized reports. Report editor undo uses a history middleware on the `report` slice.

pull_requests.title: Login with Auth0 (nextjs-auth0)
pull_requests.body: Universal Login redirect, access token passed to the API as a Bearer token.

pull_requests.title: Search page with highlighted results
pull_requests.body: Uses `GET /search` (Elasticsearch-backed) and renders ES `highlight` fragments. Debounced 250 ms.

pull_requests.title: Call /v1 API paths
pull_requests.body: Matches the API change for ADR-0007.

pull_requests.title: Report editor autosave
pull_requests.body: Saves the report 2 s after the last edit. Sends `If-Match` with the report version to detect conflicts.

pull_requests.title: Offline-first: service worker, IndexedDB drafts and photo outbox (ADR-0008)
pull_requests.body:
Implements ADR-0008.

- Workbox service worker precaches the app shell and caches `/v1` GETs (stale-while-revalidate)
- Report drafts live in IndexedDB; edits are queued in an **outbox** and replayed in order
- Photos are written to the outbox as Blobs and uploaded in the background, with retry
- Background Sync where supported; otherwise sync on app open/focus (iOS)

pull_requests.title: Compress photos client-side before queueing
pull_requests.body: Fixes #8. Resize to 2048px, JPEG q0.8, in a Web Worker so the UI doesn't stall. Originals are not kept on device.

pull_requests.title: Add /print/reports/[id] for PDF rendering
pull_requests.body: Closes #14. Print CSS with `@page` margins, photo grid (3 per row), page-break rules for findings. Token verified server-side, single use, 5-minute TTL.

pull_requests.title: Spike: reports list on TanStack Query
pull_requests.body:
Spike for #10. The reports list and report detail on TanStack Query
with the cache persisted to IndexedDB. Removes the `reports` slice and its thunks:
-612 / +140 lines. Offline: cached lists render instantly in airplane mode.

pull_requests.title: TanStack Query for reports list and detail (ADR-0011)
pull_requests.body: First migration step from ADR-0011. `QueryClient` with an IndexedDB persister; `reports` slice removed.

pull_requests.title: Migrate remaining slices to TanStack Query/Zustand and remove Redux
pull_requests.body:
Completes ADR-0011.

- clients, templates → TanStack Query
- editor UI + undo history → Zustand store with a small history middleware
- outbox status → Zustand, persisted separately (not in the query cache, per Maya's note)
- `@reduxjs/toolkit` and `react-redux` removed: -2.3k lines, bundle -38 KB

pull_requests.title: Search: render ts_headline highlights from the Postgres backend
pull_requests.body: The API now returns `highlights` from `ts_headline` (`<b>` tags) instead of ES fragments. Sanitize and render.

pull_requests.title: Switch login to WorkOS AuthKit
pull_requests.body: Replaces nextjs-auth0 with WorkOS AuthKit. SSO users are routed to their IdP by email domain. Sessions in an httpOnly cookie.

pull_requests.title: Per-field last-writer-wins merge for offline edits
pull_requests.body: Fixes #25. Outbox entries carry field paths and timestamps; the API merges per field. A banner shows when both inspectors changed the same field.

pull_requests.title: Dark mode
pull_requests.body: Follows the OS setting, with a toggle in settings. Report PDFs stay light.

pull_requests.title: WIP: compare two inspections of the same property
pull_requests.body: Early draft of a side-by-side view for re-inspections. Not ready.

markdown_files.content:
# larkspur/web

The Larkspur web app and offline-first PWA used by inspectors in the field.

- Next.js (App Router), TypeScript
- Server state: TanStack Query, persisted to IndexedDB; client state: Zustand
  ([ADR-0011](https://github.com/larkspur/handbook/blob/main/docs/adr/0011-tanstack-query-for-server-state.md))
- Offline: service worker + IndexedDB drafts + durable photo outbox
  ([ADR-0008](https://github.com/larkspur/handbook/blob/main/docs/adr/0008-offline-first-pwa.md))
- Auth: WorkOS AuthKit
- `/print/reports/[id]` is the print layout the API renders to PDF with Playwright

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm dev
```
